description.narrative: HCFC PHASE-OUT MANAGEMENT PLAN (STAGE I) HCFC phase-out strategy The main activities to be implemented during stage I of the HPMP are: conversion of foam enterprises to non-HCFC based technologies, enabling activities in the refrigeration servicing sector, including safety norms, and support to the project implementation and monitoring unit. Specific activities: # FOAM; Rigid (insulation refrigeration): Phase-out of HCFC-141b in the manufacture of insulation foam for refrigeration equipment (UNIDO) # Phase-out of HCFC-141b in the polyurethane foam sector (UNDP) # REFRIGERATION; Technical assistance/support: Enabling activities in the refrigeration and air-conditioning sector (UNIDO) # Coordination and management (UNIDO)
